worst_flaw: The design uses a team-level all-or-nothing PTO milestone with only light QA sampling (10 tickets per week across 60 agents) and no check of how CSAT bonus pressure interacts with the extra article work. That leaves room for generic or irrelevant links and for free-riding inside a team. The stagger also runs only 3 randomized waves of teams, and the workflow change in week 6 contaminates the comparison.
